method: Native engine stills at declared test stations and simulated dates. Time advancement during settling is an explicit inspection, never a spontaneous real walk. Cold scene reconstructs six simulated days; no ice override. Between unrelated stills, any prior snow coating is naturally melted through an explicitly accelerated warm-date pre-roll. Frames unretouched.
